notes: μαρτυρούμενος → *well reported of* heads on *reported*: the ASV writes no *witness* here, so the verb word is what carries the lexeme, the phrasal *of* riding inside the unit since ὑπό keeps its own *by*.
τῶν precedes its expressed head noun Ἰουδαίων, so under rule 31 it takes *the* and the intervening participle keeps the relativizer, the supplied *there* completing the participle's own English.
